name: Pretty Little Rituals
tagline: Beauty worth the splurge, essentials worth the shelf space.
description: Luxury beauty and everyday essentials from Amazon: skincare, makeup, hair and fragrance, with a splurge and an everyday pick for every step.
author: Vallari Gadre

sections.name: Skincare
sections.blurb: Cleansers, creams and sunscreen, from the splurge to the bathroom staple.

sections.name: Makeup
sections.blurb: Fast everyday faces and party looks, at both ends of the price range.

sections.name: Hair & Tools
sections.blurb: Blowouts, hair care and the beauty tools that earn their shelf space.

sections.name: Fragrance
sections.blurb: Signature perfumes, body mists and scents worth gifting.

heroAlt: A marble vanity with a luxury perfume bottle, a lipstick and a blush silk ribbon in soft light
